text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Ward Councillor has requested operating conditions be imposed on the boulevard café permit located at 269 Dunn Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 269 Dunn Avenue; and 2. The operating conditions proposed by the Ward Councillor for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 269 Dunn Avenue be considered: a. The Licensee shall ensure that the boulevard cafe is closed and cleared of patrons, food and drink, at or before 11:00 p.m. 7 days a week. b. The Licensee shall ensure that there is no outdoor music or amplified sound. c. The Licensee shall ensure that all doors and windows of the abutting premises are not left open, propped open, or allowed remaining open, while there is music or amplified sound in the interior of the abutting premises. d. The Licensee shall erect and maintain a visual barrier satisfactory to the Commissioner between the perimeter of the boulevard cafe and the abutting residential area.…
